[Story]
Xiaohua's school has a strict rule that students who do not complete their homework cannot participate in extracurricular activities. Xiaohua enjoys extracurricular activity time. Today, Xiaohua wants to participate in the school's basketball game. Xiaohua's dad asks him, "Do you want to participate in extracurricular activities today?" Xiaohua replies, "No."

[Question]
Why does Xiaohua clearly want to participate in the basketball game, but says there are no extracurricular activities?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Because he forgets there are extracurricular activities.
B. Because he wants to play basketball secretly without his dad knowing.
C. Because he actually does not like basketball.
D. Because he fears that the teacher finds out he plays without doing homework.
